# Appendix {#sec-appendix}

## Common commands

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
quarto render
```

## Repository map

- `data/raw`: immutable source extracts
- `data/processed`: validated and transformed outputs
- `src/data_pipelines`: reusable pipeline package
- `scripts/bash`: repeatable command-line entry points
- `scripts/sql`: schema, query, join, aggregation, and extraction examples
- `tests`: automated pipeline checks
- `results` and `logs`: run evidence and operational records
